name: asset_risk_profile_workflow
description: Security Extension workflow for building an asset risk profile through the centralized Security Tool.
description_cn: 安全扩展资产风险画像工作流：通过统一 Security Tool 输出画像、证据和建议

nodes.description: Call security_asset_risk_profile and expose structured workflow outputs.
nodes.code:
import json

asset_id = inputs.get('asset_id') or inputs.get('assetId')
if not asset_id:
    raise ValueError('asset_id is required')

result = tool.run_safe('security_asset_risk_profile', asset_id=asset_id)
if not result['success']:
    raise RuntimeError(result.get('error') or 'security_asset_risk_profile failed')

try:
    profile = json.loads(result.get('text') or '{}')
except Exception:
    profile = result.get('obj') or result.get('text')

if not isinstance(profile, dict):
    raise RuntimeError('security_asset_risk_profile returned an unsupported payload')

outputs['asset'] = profile.get('asset')
outputs['vulnerabilities'] = profile.get('vulnerabilities', [])
outputs['alerts'] = profile.get('alerts', [])
outputs['incidents'] = profile.get('incidents', [])
outputs['honeypot_events'] = profile.get('honeypot_events', [])
outputs['risk_profile'] = profile
outputs['risk_score'] = profile.get('risk_score')
outputs['confirmed_facts'] = profile.get('confirmed_facts', [])
outputs['evidence'] = profile.get('evidence', [])
outputs['inferences'] = profile.get('inferences', [])
outputs['uncertainties'] = profile.get('uncertainties', [])
outputs['recommended_actions'] = profile.get('recommended_actions', [])
